import parse

# What does the original code produce for .31415?
# Original regex was \d+\.\d+ which doesn't match .31415

r = parse.parse('Pi/10 = {:8.5f}', 'Pi/10 = .31415')  
print(f'Without leading zero: {r}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
